description: Source-complete Python migration baseline with explicitly bounded first-increment evidence. Partial/offline ports are not full feature or live-server parity. Module entries are partitioned into module_files for bounded review and publication.

android.remote_comparison: Identical to inventoried baseline; verified with git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main on 2026-11-07.

coverage_rule: Every git-tracked .py outside tests is inventoried, including entrypoints, production packages, tools and p4a recipes. Generated/untracked files excluded. Java/platform assets tracked separately in the human plan.

protocol: Byte-for-byte parity against source-generated vectors, including lengths and encoding.
Fragmentation, concatenated frames, overflow, malformed input and incomplete end-of-stream reject safely.
No live command enabled solely because offline codec tests pass.
state: Replay known server events and compare state fields against Python snapshots.
Reject stale account/session results; test disconnect, cancellation and repeated events.
ui: Display parity with verified snapshots; no synthetic data presented as live account state.
No blocking I/O or decoding on UI thread; test repeated open/close, navigation, late results and resize.
storage: Schema and data values match existing verified samples; corrupt/version-mismatched data rejected.
Atomic writes and safe account isolation; preserve originals on migration failure.
service: Port source-defined inputs, outputs and guards with differential fixtures.
Test limits, duplicate replies, timeout, cancellation and unknown-result stop; no unverified spending.
android: Build signed test APK and test permission denial, background/foreground, process recreation and network changes.
Platform-specific behavior must be verified on Android; desktop tests do not establish mobile parity.
tooling: Replace Python-specific build/verification steps with documented .NET equivalents where needed.
Run in CI on target platform and preserve integrity checks; removing a tool is not runtime feature parity.

status_definitions.ported_offline: Listed pure logic has passed offline parity; outstanding integration and live acceptance remain separately documented.
status_definitions.partially_migrated: Only the explicitly listed subset is ported; the rest of the source module remains outstanding.
